viewports.safetyText: Photo verification Selfie verification compares your selfie with your profile photo. It confirms a visual match, not your identity, background, or safety. Location access Location access can be approximate or precise, depending on your device permissions. PaceMatcher is designed to limit public exposure of precise location. Report and block Use in-app reporting and blocking tools when an interaction feels wrong. For meetups, choose a public place and tell someone your plans.
viewports.locationFaqAnswer: Location access can be approximate or precise depending on your device permissions. PaceMatcher is designed to limit public exposure of your precise location.
